S-001.threat: Sender spoofing: Attacker impersonates {{sourceName}} to deceive {{targetName}}
S-001.cause: Missing sender authentication on incoming data flow — {{targetName}} cannot verify the true origin of received data
S-001.attack: Attacker forges the identity of {{sourceName}} and sends malicious data to {{targetName}}, which processes it as legitimate

S-002.threat: Receiver spoofing: Attacker impersonates {{targetName}} to intercept data from {{sourceName}}
S-002.cause: Missing endpoint validation before data transmission — {{sourceName}} cannot verify the true identity of the receiving endpoint
S-002.attack: Attacker sets up a rogue endpoint pretending to be {{targetName}}, causing {{sourceName}} to send sensitive data to the attacker
